hold_text: DISARMED ON PURPOSE, and the reason is measured rather than cautious. The manager authorised landing:self for this Tier-1 test fix and I armed it — but R13 requires an arming branch to claim `merge_slot` in docs/claude/session-board.json, which is the HOTTEST FILE IN THE REPO: 15 commits in the last 3 hours on main, one every ~12 minutes, against a ~20-minute pytest-run. This PR reached 5/5 GREEN twice and was re-dirtied by an unrelated manager heartbeat both times, on that one file, before it could merge. Arming it therefore CANNOT converge — the claim is what makes it conflict. Disarmed, the diff is tests/test_manager_wake.py plus this landing file, which collide with nothing and stay mergeable indefinitely. ⚠️ IT NEEDS ONE MERGE CLICK AND SHOULD GET IT AHEAD OF EVERYTHING: main is RED on a clean checkout (tests/test_manager_wake.py::test_brief_is_self_contained_state_not_a_link_to_go_read, re-verified on a freshly fetched origin/main worktree), so every open PR in the repo is red and no session can tell it apart from their own failure. The merge slot is released back to main's version; I hold nothing.
why: One test file. tests/test_manager_wake.py stops pinning a superseded cycle id as a string literal and reads the one docs/claude/work/MANAGER-CHECKLIST.json declares. No src/, no config/, no workflows, no deploy, no order path, no register mutation. `tests/` is Tier-1 by the canonical tier table.
